$comment: Shared VfLink cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the native branch of the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963: one anchor, href/target/rel, the rel derivation, two modifiers, and whatever a consumer forwards. The Vue component's other branch - `to`, `component`, the RouterLink handoff and the literal unresolved element Vue renders with no router registered - is deliberately absent from this catalog. It is not a cross-platform contract: it is Vue resolving a component by name and passing a destination through untouched, and a Razor target has no router to hand anything to. Those behaviours are pinned by VfLink.characterization.spec.ts; a case here that named `to` would be describing a component two of the three targets cannot render, and the coverage gate rejects it. Every case declares componentInteractive: the number of anchors the component itself renders that are controls, which is one when there is an href and zero for the no-destination anchor - an `<a>` without href is inert, not focusable and absent from the accessibility tree, and the ownership stage must measure that rather than assume every anchor is a link. Cases whose slot content is interactive declare consumerInteractive as well.

propVocabulary.href: string, default undefined. The native destination. An empty string is written as an empty attribute; no href at all renders an inert anchor.
propVocabulary.target: string, default undefined. Written as given.
propVocabulary.rel: string, default undefined. Written as given when truthy; otherwise derived as 'noopener noreferrer' for target='_blank' and nothing for any other target.
propVocabulary.underline: 'none' | 'hover' | 'always', default 'none'. hover and always emit vf-link--underline-hover / vf-link--underline-always; none emits nothing.
propVocabulary.tone: 'default' | 'muted', default 'default'. muted emits vf-link--muted after the underline modifier; default emits nothing.

slotVocabulary.default: The link content, rendered straight into the anchor with no wrapper. `markup: 'label'` puts the text in a consumer span; `control` adds a real consumer button after it.

cases.title: A native link: one anchor with href and the text as its content
An empty-string href is written as an empty attribute and the anchor is still a link

No href at all: an anchor that is not a control - no href, no role, no tabindex, not focusable, ignored by the accessibility tree. The component owns zero interactive controls here and the ownership stage must say so
target=_blank with no rel derives rel="noopener noreferrer"
target=_blank with an explicit rel keeps the explicit value and does not merge the default into it
An explicit rel with no target is written as given
underline=always emits vf-link--underline-always and paints the underline at rest
tone=muted emits vf-link--muted and repaints the text colour
Both modifiers, with the underline modifier before the tone modifier
A consumer class after the canonical classes, plus style, id and a product data attribute on the anchor
Consumer ARIA on an anchor that writes none of its own: a name, aria-current=page, and a description that resolves outside the anchor
Consumer markup in the slot renders straight into the anchor with no wrapper
A consumer control inside the anchor. The component owns the anchor; the button is the consumer's, and the ownership stage tells the two apart
